basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Mangalagiri has 28 Senior Resident and Senior Demonstrator posts open across 20 departments, with Anaesthesiology alone accounting for 5. Applications are accepted through a Google Form until 21 November 2026, and the notice makes clear there is no walk-in interview. Candidates with the listed postgraduate qualification and an age of up to 45 years can apply. Medical candidates start at an entry pay of Rs. 67,700/- in Pay Level-11.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Mangalagiri
content_sections.text: AIIMS Mangalagiri is a healthcare Institute of National Importance in Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh. It was established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojna (PMSSY), and is an autonomous institute.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident and Senior Demonstrator Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Medical candidates are paid as per the 7th CPC, in Pay Level-11 of the Pay Matrix, with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus NPA and other allowances. Non-medical candidates (M.Sc with Ph.D) get Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 under the 7th CPC plus other allowances. Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident and Senior Demonstrator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years, as on the closing date of applications. Age, qualifications and experience are all counted on this crucial date. Each post requires a postgraduate medical degree from a recognized university or institute, or an equivalent qualification, as listed below. The prescribed qualification is a minimum, and holding it does not by itself entitle a candidate to selection. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Reservation Rules and Category Certificates
content_sections.text: Reservation for OBC, EWS, SC and ST candidates follows Central Government rules, and PwBD reservation is 4% on a horizontal basis. OBC candidates need a valid non-creamy layer certificate in the prescribed format, issued on or after 1 April 2026. Their sub-caste must match the Central List of OBCs. EWS candidates need a valid certificate in the prescribed format, also issued on or after 1 April 2026. SC, ST, OBC and EWS certificates must be issued by a Tahsildar or an authority of higher rank. Unfilled EWS posts are not carried forward, so UR candidates may also apply provisionally against them. PwBD reservation is open to persons with not less than 40% physical disability, who must submit a Disability Certificate from a competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and is paid by NEFT/UPI to this account:

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of the interview only. If the number of applicants is high, the Institute will hold a screening test of MCQs in the subject concerned and then interview the shortlisted candidates. Document verification takes place before the interview, and the Screening Committee may shortlist candidates based on the verification of original documents. Candidates report to the Ground Floor, Admin and Library Building, AIIMS Mangalagiri, Guntur (Dist), Andhra Pradesh, 522503. Marks of the written test (if applicable) or interview are not displayed, and there is no re-checking or re-evaluation. Interview turns may be delayed depending on the number of applicants. No travelling or other allowances are paid for attending the screening test or interview, or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is under the Government of India's Residency Scheme, and engagement is regulated as per the CCS (Temporary Service Rules). Either side can end the appointment by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. The appointment can also be terminated for failure to complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. Appointees may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute, at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent, Dean or Director. Additional duties may be assigned, with no extra allowance. Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion and other benefits of regular Government servants are not available. Leave follows Institute rules and Government of India instructions. No NOC will be given within one month of joining, and no experience certificate will be given to those resigning within 1 month after joining. Selected candidates must be declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board. Selected candidates get 14 days to join. An extension may be granted in exceptional situations, and if a candidate does not join, the offer stands cancelled and the post goes to a waitlisted candidate, if any. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law, and any pending disciplinary proceedings must be reported in writing at document verification. Canvassing leads to disqualification, and incomplete applications are rejected. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a walk-in interview at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: No. The notice states "No Walk-in Interview", so candidates must first apply through the Google Form.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.Sc candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, in Anatomy and Pharmacology, if they also hold a Ph.D as specified for that department. Their pay is Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. Do I pay again if I apply to two departments?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate fee is required for each department, so a General candidate applying to two departments pays Rs. 1500/- for each.

faq.question: Q4. How long does the appointment last?
faq.answer: It is a whole-time appointment for 12 months at a time and can continue up to 3 years. Continuation depends on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.

faq.question: Q5. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if the number of applicants is high. In that case, an MCQ screening test in the subject concerned comes before the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply if my postgraduate result is still awaited?
faq.answer: Only candidates declared successful in the qualifying degree examination, who will complete its tenure on or before 21 November 2026, are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a government institute. What do I need?
faq.answer: You must apply through proper channel and produce an original No Objection Certificate from your employer at the interview. It must clearly state that you will be permitted to join AIIMS Mangalagiri if selected.

faq.question: Q8. Can a Senior Resident do private practice?
faq.answer: No. Private practice of any kind is prohibited, and appointees cannot accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, during the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Can UR candidates be selected against EWS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, they may be considered if suitable EWS candidates are not found. There are 5 EWS posts in this advertisement.
